description: Ministry of Development Strategies & International Trade - Identifying that the Project for Development of Colombo Port City as a Strategic Development Project and the Project Company is M/S Chec Port City Colombo (Private) Limited - An Order made to amend the S & E notices of this Order has been published in Gaz. reasoning: This gazette notification is a legal/regulatory instrument issued under the Strategic Development Projects Act, No. 14 of 2008.
